title: SDD Forge workflow-scenario fixture (tests/workflow-scenarios/, epic-136-phase3 T-004 / Stream C / issue #125)
description: Per-scenario document shape for tests/workflow-scenarios/<scenario-id>.json. fixture_profile is a VERBATIM reuse of docs/adr/0010-loop-inventory-and-fixture-vocabulary.md's closed vocabulary (Decision item 2) -- the exact enum tests/loops/loop-inventory.json:25,47,70,94,115,137,151,165 already carries on all 8 of its own loop entries. No new fixture-classification value is introduced by this schema; ADR-0010 remains the sole normative authority for this field (workflow-scenarios.tests.sh's own TEST-012 asserts this enum is byte-for-byte identical to loop-inventory.json's, not merely visually similar).

scenario_id.description: Matches this document's own filename (without .json), e.g. "greenfield-cli".

class_number.description: 1-indexed position in issue #125's own verbatim 10-class list (investigation.md INV-017). Exactly one scenario document maps to each of 1..10 -- no gap, no duplicate.

class_name_source.description: Citation of where this class's name/wording comes from (issue #125 body / investigation.md INV-017 row), never invented fresh.

fixture_profile.description: Closed set, ADR-0010 Decision item 2 -- verbatim reuse of loop-inventory.json's own field. No third value is ever valid here.

coverage_kind.description: "existing-coverage": this scenario references a class investigation.md INV-017 already found tested elsewhere (coverage_refs required, no duplicate assertion authored here). "net-new": this class has no scenario-level test before this task (refactor-baseline-missing, inbound-prompt-injection only).

coverage_refs.description: Required when coverage_kind == existing-coverage (see the conditional below); the repository-relative file(s)/line(s) investigation.md INV-017 cites as this class's existing coverage. workflow-scenarios.tests.sh's TEST-012 confirms every cited path actually exists on disk (a traceability-integrity check, not merely a textual claim).

policy_ref.description: Optional: for a net-new scenario anchored to a documented policy (not an existing TEST), the governing reference doc this scenario's assertion reads read-only (e.g. quality-gate-calibration.md).

entry_point.description: Named target entry point this scenario proves behavior against, present only for scenario 5 (inbound-prompt-injection) per design.md API/Contract Plan and OQ-6.

tool_name_shapes.description: requirements.md Field Definitions, REQ-003 leg: this scenario's PreToolUse payload is driven with at least one Claude-Code-shaped and one Codex-shaped tool_name (AC-013).

assertion_summary.description: One-paragraph description of what workflow-scenarios.tests.sh actually checks for this scenario id (traceability-integrity check for existing-coverage classes; a real fixture-driven assertion for the 2 net-new classes).
